basics.name: Ahmet Bedir
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Senior Full-Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience leading the development of enterprise-grade SaaS, marketplace, and e-commerce platforms. Deep expertise in PHP/Laravel, system architecture, microservices, and API integrations. Known for improving performance, reducing operational bottlenecks, and driving engineering excellence. Strong background in Docker, CI/CD automation, cloud infrastructure, and Agile delivery.

work.name: The Despatch Company
work.summary: Leading backend architecture and full-stack delivery for a SaaS platform streamlining multi-channel e-commerce and logistics operations.
highlights: Architected and built scalable SaaS e-commerce and multi-channel logistics integrations using PHP, Laravel, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Designed RESTful API-driven microservices and modules for order processing, inventory synchronization, and warehouse workflows.
Engineered real-time shipment tracking and branded customer return portals with Vue.js, Livewire, and Filament.
Managed AWS (EC2, S3) and Docker-based infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, and mentored developers through code reviews.

work.name: Tek Kılavuz Digital Performance Agency
work.summary: Developed custom e-commerce platforms, CRM applications, and business automation software for agency clients.
highlights: Delivered high-performance e-commerce platforms and custom web applications using PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, Vue.js, and MySQL.
Built tailored CRM and business automation systems to streamline client sales, reporting, and operational workflows.
Administered Linux hosting environments, optimized web servers and database queries, and ensured high availability across client projects.

work.name: Sisoft Healthcare Information Systems
work.summary: Provided technical support, troubleshooting, and operational maintenance for hospital information management systems.
highlights: Diagnosed and resolved production software and database issues for hospital information management systems across healthcare institutions.
Collaborated with engineering teams to improve system uptime, stability, and day-to-day usability for healthcare staff.
